pairs.subject: accessibility
pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/components/buttons/AsyncButton.tsx:9 AsyncButton detects reduced motion with framer-motion's hook instead of the repo's single signal (useMotion.ts, which also reads the in-app Appearance toggle), so a user who turns on reduced motion in the app still gets AsyncButton's swap animation.

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/components/buttons/AsyncButton.tsx:9 Detects the preference ad hoc and skips the in-app override. FullScreenOverlay.tsx:24 imports the repo hook correctly.
src/features/shared/components/layout/SegmentedTabs.tsx:144 Roving tabindex with arrow-key handling inside a role=tablist. PanelTabBar does the same.

src/features/shared/components/buttons/Button.tsx:102 Button offers icon-only sizes (icon-xs to icon-lg, line 24), but nothing in the props requires an accessible name for them and there is no dev check, so nameless icon buttons compile.
src/features/shared/components/buttons/CopyButton.tsx:79 The icon-only CopyButton is now named by aria-label, not by title alone. That part of the earlier verdict is fixed.
src/features/shared/components/buttons/CopyButton.tsx:136 The 'copied' result only swaps the visible label. Nothing in the file calls the announcer, so the result may never be spoken.
